response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), so RET-020 applies. At priority 90, it dominates the out-of-window ineligibility rule RET-008 (priority 10), which would otherwise apply since days_since_delivery (48) > 30. RET-012 does not apply because final_sale is False, and no fraud hold or goodwill grant is present.
